Daily Singles

Pocket Prints

Everything here is a phone wallpaper, and we make them for any phone and any screen, not only the Duo. We add new singles to Zedge every day. Some are photographs of real places. Some are drawn for true black screens, so the blacks stay black. Some of them are space. Some are animals. Whatever season we are in turns up too. We look every piece over before it goes up. Packs we make ourselves

The singles above live on Zedge. These packs are ours end to end, and they live on Ko-fi.

AMOLED True Black Phone Wallpaper Pack

We drew these for the way an AMOLED screen works: one lit motif at a time on pure black, so the dark pixels switch off and the light floats. A crescent moon over a pine, an ember star above a ridge, a wave in a single line. The top of every design stays clear for your clock, and each one comes sized for Samsung and iPhone.

Texture-Look Phone Wallpaper Pack

Twelve warm neutral texture fields with a boucle look, a knit look, and a flax weave look, drawn by us as illustrations, not photographs of fabric. No scene and no slogan, just a calm field behind your clock and icons, with two carrying one thin ember line.
